caption:
A just energy transition is not only changing how we power the world.

It is changing who gets to shape its future.

Across the Global South, new opportunities are emerging in the energy space, from solar and e-mobility to AI powered by clean power.

By 2050, this shift could create 40 million new jobs. 

But this transition will only be just if young people can see themselves in it, learn from it, and lead it.

That is why we want to hear from you.

Join the #CleanEnergy challenge on @Goodwall.

Record a 30-second video. Share what you know about clean energy. Earn your sustainable energy badge.

Any language. English captions. Go.
